title: Section 44A — Execution of decrees of reciprocating territory — CPC 1908

content.heading: Execution of decrees passed by Courts in reciprocating territory
content.text: Where a certified copy of a decree of any of the superior Courts of any reciprocating territory has been filed in a District Court, the decree may be executed in India as if it had been passed by the District Court. Together with the certified copy of the decree shall be filed a certificate from such superior Court stating the extent, if any, to which the decree has been satisfied or adjusted. Sections 47 and Order XXI apply with the enacted modifications, and execution may be refused on the grounds in Section 13.
